summary:
Talent Acquisition professional with 11+ years of experience in global hiring across
Technology, Analytics, and Consulting domains. Experienced in managing end-to-end
recruitment lifecycle, stakeholder management, workforce planning, and global hiring
across India, US, and South Africa. Proven track record in improving offer-to-join ratio,
reducing time-to-hire, and building strong sourcing pipelines through LinkedIn, referrals,
and job portals.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Workforce Planning→Resource Planning(100%), hiring→Recruitment(100%), recruitment→Recruitment(100%), stakeholder management→Stakeholder Management(100%), workforce planning→Resource Planning(100%)...)

bullets: Managed end-to-end hiring for 30–40 technology and business roles annually.
Reduced time-to-fill by 20% through proactive sourcing and structured hiring planning.
Maintained 70%+ offer-to-join ratio through effective candidate engagement.
Built direct sourcing pipeline contributing to 75% of hires, reducing dependency on external agencies.
Developed recruitment dashboards to track hiring pipeline and workforce metrics.

bullets: Led global recruitment across India, US, and South Africa for technology roles.
Delivered 45+ hires within 17 months across critical technical positions.

Improved onboarding turnaround time by 40% through structured recruitment processes.
Managed end-to-end onboarding operations for 70–100 hires annually.
Ensured 90%+ joining ratio through improved candidate engagement.
Generated recruitment reports and hiring dashboards using PeopleSoft.
Partnered with HR leadership to support diversity hiring initiatives.
Implemented HRMS solutions for 10+ corporate clients annually.
Gathered business requirements and prepared functional specification documents.
Led HRMS implementation projects with 95% on-time go-live delivery.
Managed employee onboarding, HR operations, and engagement initiatives.
Conducted employee orientation and handled HR lifecycle processes.
Designed employee engagement initiatives to improve retention.
